questions.text: Differentiate between the Din and Religion, state the important points of Co-existence among Islam and world religions in the present scenario.
The most important issue of humanity is the recognition of the role and privileges of a man. Discuss how Islam may play a role in this regard in today's scenario.
Stating traditional and rational arguments about faith of Resurrection, discuss the role of this faith in establishing an organised society.
Describing the importance of Ethical values in Islam, write a comparative note on Islamic morality code and Western code.
Keeping in view today's International Political System, can Shariah be adjusted in the Islamic Societies?
In the light of the Islamic teachings Faith and Ethics are closely united, inspite of that Islamic Societies are in disorder. Discuss.
Keeping in view the requirements of Global Society, determine the freedom and limitations of a Muslim Woman in the light of Islamic teachings.
In the globalization arena what role Muslim Ummah can play being custodian of Revealed Knowledge to resolve the complex problems of human kind.

To follow an ideal is very necessary for the progress of nation. In your view what are basic characteristics of ideal and how Islamic ideology of life affects the individual and communal life with reference to basic characteristics of Islamic ideology? Elucidate.
What is meant by civilization and culture and how it effects collective life and also analyse the foundations of modern civilization and highlight the problems caused by it?
Discuss the concept of veil and freedom of women from Islamic point of view while analysing the law against veil in France.

It is necessary to establish priority for law for the development of society. What is your point of view that today Islamic punishments are regarded as savagery? While discussing the Islamic philosophy of the reward and punishment also describe the basic characteristics of Islamic concept of punishments.
It is the period of basic human rights. What is meant by human rights and what is a western concept of human rights, discuss human rights of Islam in the light of the sermon of Hajjatul Widah.

In the present period the Muslim Ummah is facing different problems and for the solution of these problems "Ijtehad" is necessary, so point out such an institution that can offer solution to the new problems with the help of Ijtehad.
Discuss in detail the importance of Akle-Halal from Islamic Point of view and explain how unfair resources can be checked in the light of Islamic teachings?
In the present era, Muslim Ummah has all the resources, but it is the victim of disunity, while analysing the reasons of disunity, suggest measures to maintain unity among the Muslim Ummah.
What is meant by Day of Judgement? What are its impacts on human life?
In the Light of "إِنَّ الصَّلَاةَ تَنْهَىٰ عَنِ الْفَحْشَاءِ وَالْمُنكَرِ", Describe the advantages and effects of prayer?
The political system of Islam guarantees the prosperity of State. Discuss.
Describe the concept of modern civilization and its effects on Muslim Ummah.
Islam is a complete code of life. Discuss.
Discuss human rights of Islam in the of the sermon of Hajjatul Wida.
Explain the economical rules of Islam in the light of Social Justice.
Describe the necessity and importance of religion for man and its effects on human life.
What do you mean by Shariah? Elaborate the different sources of Shariah.
Discuss in detail the collection and compilation of Quran.
What is Human Dignity? Explain how Islam recognised it and what efforts have been adopted to maintain the superiority of man?
Describe the importance and philosophy of Fasting (SAUM). Also explain its individual and collective benefits.
Define Tauheed (Unity of Allah) in a scholarly manner describing its significance and effects on human life.
What is the significance of "Jihad" in the light of Quran and Sunnah? What are its kinds, principles and conditions?
Define and explain the Judicio-Politicial System of Islam.
Write down in detail the problems of "Ummah" in the contemporary world.
Discuss the concept of veil and freedom of women from Islamic point of view while analysing the law against veil in France.
The Holy Quran is the Fountain-head at all kind of knowledge, Discuss.
Discuss the possibilities of establishment of an Islamic state under the present political system of democracy.
Describe the Islamic concept of peace in the light of Qur'an and Sunnah.
Describe the wisdom of gradual revelation of Qur'an for Islamic Law.
Describe the limitations of co-existence and contradictions in the Islamic and Western Social System.
Describe the status and aim of Islamic Ummah in the light of "أنتم الأعلون إن كنتم مؤمنين"
Give a comparative review on the role of woman in Islam and Modern Society.
Good combination of the reason (intellect) and Revelation can resolves today's issues of humankind. Discuss.
In the presence of Interest based global financial system, dicuss the possibility of interest free Islamic financial system
Explain the concept & structure of Muslim Ummah and give suggestions for its revival.
What is the difference between Jihad and Fasaad (Hostility)? Discuss the possibilities of practical application of Quranic concept of Jihad in current international scenario.
The entire faith in Prophethood is unacceptable without faith in finality of the Prophethood. Discuss in the light of Quran & Sunnah.
Highlight the importance of Zakat and prove that economic stability of a society can be ensured through its effective implementation.
Write a comprehensive note on the importance of Sunnah in interpretation and legislation.
Argue for supremacy of 'Wahi' as the solution of human problems against other sources of knowledge.
Stability of modern society depends upon a strong family system in the light of Islamic principles. Discuss.
Give a comparison of Islamic ideology and modern Western thought about present trends of individuality.
What is meant by culture and civilization? Describe the characteristics of Islamic culture.
What is the difference between Deen and Religion? Describe the importance of Deen in human life with arguments.
Describe the characteristics of Military strategist in the light of Sirah of Muhammad (PBUH) with arguments.
Define the meaning of prayer and its different categories. Also describe the spiritual, moral and social impact of prayers.
Highlight the concept of Public Administration in Islam. Explain the responsibilities of Civil Servants.
Discuss the salient features of Islamic political system in the light of governance under pious Khilafat-i-Rashida.
What are the contemporary challenges of Muslim world? Suggest its solutions in the light of Quran and Sunnah?
Who are entitled to receive Zakat according to the Quran? Elucidating social impact of Zakat, clarify how can poverty be alleviated with its distribution in Islamic Society?
Write a comprehensive note on the right of inheritance granted to women by Islam.
How were the Rightly-guided Caliphs elected? To what extent their system of government be regarded as democratic?
Elucidate how the Prophet of Islam (Peace be upon him) exemplified him as the greatest peace maker in the world by making reconciliation with pagans, Jews and Christians?
Explain the concept of self-purification in the light of the Qur’ān and Sunnah and its impact on society.
Enumerate the reasons of extremism in Pakistan and suggest solutions to eradicate it in the light of Islamic teachings.
Define Ijma’ (consensus) and explain its different kinds. Highlight its importance in the light of the Qur’ān and Sunnah.
Define Ijtihad, also highlight its contemporary importance in the light of Islamic Fiqh.
What is Self-purification and Ehsan? Explain it in the light of Quran and Sunnah, also describe its individual and collective impacts.
Point out the motives of terrorism in Pakistan. How can the society get rid of terrorism?
Highlight the responsibilities of civil servants in the light of Islamic teachings.
Write a comprehensive note on Zakat system of Islam and its spiritual, moral and social impacts.
Describe, in detail, the basic characteristics of Islamic civilization.
The Holy Prophet (ﷺ) is the prophet of peace and safety. Explain with arguments.
Define Tauheed. What is its impact on individual life and the society? Elaborate.
Give a general estimate of Holy Prophet's (pbuh) character in the battle fields as commander.
Describe the rights of women in Islam in the context of current wave the feminist movement
Through light in detail on the moral value system of Islam as significant feature Islamic civilization.
Write a comprehensive note on Hajj (the pilgrimage) system of Islam and its spiritual, moral and social impacts.
Is extremism a challenge to Islam? Discuss in the context of contemporary challenges faced by Muslim Ummah.
Give suggestions to reform Pakistani Politics keeping in view the different aspects of political system of Islam.
Discuss the status and grade of “Tolerance and Forgivness” in the life of the Holly Prophet (PBUH).
Write a comprehensive note on the bravery and juridical Wisdom of Hazrat Ali (R.A)
“The last Sermon of the Holy Prophet (PBUH) is the basic document for awakening of conscious of mankind for human rights”. Discuss.
Discuss in detail the principles and terms & conditions for “Jihad” in the light of Quran and Sunnah.
Analyze the Madina Accord as a “Social Contract” in detail.
“Islam teaches the lesson of human respect and dignity irrespective of colour, race and creed”. Discuss.
“Islamic Financial and Economic system is the solution of the human financial problems”. Discuss.
What is belief in the Day of Judgment ? Explore its effects on individual and collective lives of human beings.
Islam provides better rights to men and women than all other religions. Explore with arguments.
Comment on the teachings of Islam regarding co-existence in a multi-faith society.
Islamophobia is a sign of extremism. Give suggestions for its remedy.
Express the principles of accountability of rulers according to the Holy Quarn and Sunnah.
Explore the importance of Sufism to spread out Islam. Is the amelioration of current deviation possible through Sufism?
Treaty of Hudaybiyya as a pact of peace.
Benefits acquired from Battle of Khayber.
Explain the concept of Human Rights in Islamic thought in specification of “Status of Women in Islam”.
Write down the main principles of Islamic Economics. How does these principles provide solutions to contemporary challenges?
Elaborate the concept and importance of Ijtihad and explain its principles.
Explain the doctrine of Prophethood and its importance in human life.
Describe Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ) as a Prophet of Peace for contemporary transnational world.
Explain the Reconstruction of Pakistani Society in the light of Islamic Teachings.
Describe the importance of Deen (Doctrine of life) in human life. Differentiate between Deen and Religions.
What is the Qur’anic argument on the Life Hereafter? What are its impacts on the individual and collective life of a human being?
Discuss the Holy Prophet’s (ﷺ) Role as a Model for Military Strategy.
Elaborate the rights of daughters granted by Islam and how these are denied by Muslims in the contemporary world?
Define Ijma‘(consensus) and explain its different kinds. Can legislation by a parliament of an Islamic state be regarded as a valid consensus?
Analyze the Charter of Madina as a social contract.
What are the motives of extremism in Pakistan? How can the society get rid of extremism by following the teachings of Islam?
Human rights in the light of the Sermon of Farewell Pilgrimage.
Social Justice in an Islamic Society.
Self-purification is an essential element for the evolution of society. Explain.
The main purpose of Ghazwat-e-Nabawi (ﷺ) was to establish peace. Explain.
Explain the doctrine of Prophet hood and its importance in human life.
How does Islam highlight human dignity and greatness? Discuss.
How can the system of accountability in Pakistan be idealized in the teachings of the Holy Prophet (ﷺ)? Explain.
How is it possible to eliminate the religious and political extremism in Pakistan in the light of the teachings of the Holy Prophet (ﷺ)? Explain.
Ijtihad
The importance of epistles of Hazrat Ali (رضی اللہ عنہ)
What is the importance of Makarim Akhlaq (noble morals) in establishing social peace? In this background, how did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ complete these morals?
What is meant by Farz Kifayah? What is its religious and social significance? In the present era, which affairs are considered to be included in the scope of Farz Kifayah?
Determine the status of the classist lifestyle in the light of the teachings of Islam and examine its effects on human society.
What are the disadvantages of concentration of wealth? What economic measures has Islam introduced to prevent this?
Discuss the contents of the peace agreements made during the Prophet’s era, by determining the parties thereof.
Discuss religious tolerance in the context of post-Prophetic Muslim history.
What views are found in today's Muslim circles about Western Civilization? Identify and analyze them.
Provide a comparative and critical analysis of the human rights granted by Islam with those enshrined in the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR).
In the light of plight of Indian and Kashmiri Muslims, discuss the justification and demands of the Tow-Nation Theory.
Explain, how Western civilization has influenced Islamic civilization. Discuss the measures to protect Muslim societies from the negative impacts of Western culture.
What are the rational arguments for the existence of Allah? Explain the impacts of the belief in monotheism on human life.
Explain the concept of accountability in the Islamic system. Demonstrate with examples that the practices of the (Khulafā' Rāshidīn) Rashidun Caliphs in this perspective set the highest standard.
Examine the causes of sectarianism and polarization in the Muslim World. Suggest solutions in the light of Islamic teachings.
What are the challenges for the ‘institution of family and its role’ in the present era? Discuss them in the light of Islamic teachings.
